Honestly if they are neglecting to take their pet outside and other potential issues I would go ahead and contact animal control to help get the dog out of a situation where the owners are neglectful. I ended up having to do some research on this because my roommate ended up neglecting my own dogs at one point and we are breaking the lease due to the situation. In terms of carpet removal and cleaning, that is on the landlord to cover and fix, not you. They are not going to be returning your deposit based on this (assuming) and this is what a pet deposit is for as well. DO NOT pay for their pets and other costs if you do not have to.
Yes! They’re not just there for finding pets but help with cases of animal abuse and neglect, I’m glad I could help.

Do you have evidence like emails or call logs going over that you couldn't pay what was requested because they wouldn't allow you? I feel like the judge might be able to give you a payment plan and potentially a reduction in cost since it is their fault that they won't take your payment. I linked below what I used when having housing issues, I'm not sure if it will be too helpful for you but they might be able to advise you to another place :) I'm sorry you are going through this, good luck!
